questions.question: Divyansh's birthday is on Sunday 16 th July. On what day of the week will be Shaan's Birthday in the same year if Shaan was born on 1 st August?
questions.questionHtml: Divyansh's birthday is on Sunday 16th July. On what day of the week will be Shaan's Birthday in the same year if Shaan was born on 1st August?
questions.solution:
16th July = Sunday

Total number of days from 17th July to 1st Aug = 15 (of July) + 1 (of August) = 16

Odd days = 16/7 = 2

So, day on 1st August = Sunday + 2 = Tuesday

Hence, Shaan’s birthday is on Tuesday.

questions.question: If 26#14 = 80; 5#3 = 16; 6#5 = 22; then what is the value of 14#5 = ?
questions.questionHtml: If 26#14 = 80; 5#3 = 16; 6#5 = 22; then what is the value of 14#5 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is that both the numbers are added, and result is multiplied by 2,

26#14 = 80

→ (26 + 14) × 2 = 80

5#3 = 16

→ (5 + 3) × 2 = 16

6#5 = 22

→ (6 + 5) × 2 = 22

Similarly;

(14 + 5) × 2 = 38

Hence, correct answer is 38.

questions.question: The _________ of a firm is a relationship between inputs used and output produced by the firm.

questions.solution: In economics, a production function relates physical output of a production process to physical inputs or factors of production. questions.question: Select the correct option: Convert decimal 101 to binary
questions.questionHtml: Select the correct option: Convert decimal 101 to binary
questions.solution:
To convert 101 into binary:

Step 1: divide (101)10 successively by 2 until the quotient is 0:

101/2 = 50, remainder is 1, 50/2 = 25, remainder is 0

25/2 = 12, remainder is 1, 12/2 = 6, remainder is 0

6/2 = 3, remainder is 0, 3/2 = 1, remainder is 1, 1/2 = 0, remainder is 1

Step 2: Read from bottom (MSB) to top (LSB) as 1100101. This is the binary equivalent of decimal number 101.

questions.question: A can paint a house in 42 days and B can do it in 21 days. Along with C, they can finish the job in 7 days only. C alone can do the painting job in how many days?
questions.questionHtml: A can paint a house in 42 days and B can do it in 21 days. Along with C, they can finish the job in 7 days only. C alone can do the painting job in how many days?
questions.solution:
1 day’s work of A = 1/42

1 day’s work of B = 1/21

Let C alone can do the painting job in x days

According to the question,

1/42 + 1/21 + 1/x = 1/7

⇒ 3/42 + 1/x = 1/7

⇒ 1/x = 1/7 - 1/14 = 1/14

⇒ x = 14

∴ C alone can do the painting job in 14 days.

questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of a circle whose circumference is 26.4 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the area (in sq cm) of a circle whose circumference is 26.4 cm?
questions.solution:
Circumference of a circle is 26.4 cm

Let r cm be the radius of the circle

So, 2πr = 26.4

⇒ r = 26.4/2π

⇒ r = 4.2 cm

∴ Area of the circle = πr2 = 22/7 × 4.2 × 4.2 = 55.44 cm2

questions.question: The cost price of an article is x. It is marked up by 120%. It is sold at Rs 8800 after giving 20% discount. What is the value (in Rs) of x?
questions.questionHtml: The cost price of an article is x. It is marked up by 120%. It is sold at Rs 8800 after giving 20% discount. What is the value (in Rs) of x?
questions.solution:
Cost price of the article = Rs. X

Marked price of the article = X + X × 120/100 = 2.2X

And, Selling price of the article = 2.2X × 80/100 = 1.76X

According to the question,

Selling price of the article = Rs. 8800

⇒ 1.76X = 8800

⇒ X = 8800/1.76

⇒ X = Rs. 5000

∴ Cost price of the article = Rs. 5000

questions.question: A bag has Rs 43 in the form of 5-rupee, 50-paise and 10-paise coins in the ratio of 1 : 5 : 11. What is the total number of 50-paise coins?
questions.questionHtml: A bag has Rs 43 in the form of 5-rupee, 50-paise and 10-paise coins in the ratio of 1 : 5 : 11. What is the total number of 50-paise coins?
questions.solution:
Let number of coins in the form of 5-rupee, 50-paise and 10-paise in the bag is x, 5x and 11x respectively

Total Amount = 43

⇒ x × 5 + 5x × 1/2 + 11x × 1/10 = 43

⇒ (50x + 25x + 11x)/10 = 43

⇒ 50x + 25x + 11x = 430

⇒ 86x = 430

⇒ x = 430/86

⇒ x = 5

∴ The total number of 50-paise coins = 5 × 5 = 25

questions.question: In the first 45 overs of a 50 over innings, the run rate was 5.8 runs per over. What is the required run rate in the remaining overs to reach the target of 295 runs?
questions.questionHtml: In the first 45 overs of a 50 over innings, the run rate was 5.8 runs per over. What is the required run rate in the remaining overs to reach the target of 295 runs?

Total runs in first 45 overs = 45 × 5.8 = 261 runs

Total runs in 50 overs = 295 runs

∴ The required run rate in the remaining overs = (295 - 261)/5 = 6.8 runs per over

questions.question: A milkman buys milk at Rs. 24 per litre. He adds 1/5 of water to it and sells the mixture at Rs. 32 per litre. What will be his gain (in %)?
questions.questionHtml: A milkman buys milk at Rs. 24 per litre. He adds 1/5 of water to it and sells the mixture at Rs. 32 per litre. What will be his gain (in %)?
questions.solution:
Formula used:

Profit = S.P. – C.P.

Profit % = (P/C.P.) × 100 

Where

P → Profit

S.P. → Selling price

C.P. → Cost price 

Calculations:

Given: Cost price of milk = Rs. 24/L

Let the total amount of milk be a litres

Water added = a/5

Cost price of milk = 24a

Selling price of milk = 32(a + a/5) = 32(6a/5) = 38.4a

Profit = SP - CP = 38.4a - 24a = 14.4a

∴ Profit % = (14.4a/24a) × 100 = 60% (approx.)

questions.question: When a number is increased by 105, it becomes 135% of itself. What is the number?

Let the number be a

⇒ a + 105 = a(135/100)

questions.question: Two cyclists P and Q cycle at 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr towards each other respectively. What was the distance (in kms) between them when they started if they met after 40 minutes?
questions.questionHtml: Two cyclists P and Q cycle at 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr towards each other respectively. What was the distance (in kms) between them when they started if they met after 40 minutes?

questions.question: If a - b = -1 and ab = 6, then what is the value of a 3 - b 3 ?
questions.questionHtml: If a - b = -1 and ab = 6, then what is the value of a3 - b3?
questions.solution:
We know that: (a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

Given: a - b = -1 and ab = 6

⇒ -13 = a3 - b3 - 3(6)(-1)

⇒ -1 = a3 - b3 + 18

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 31/6. What is the fraction?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 31/6. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be a

⇒ a + 3(1/a) = 31/6

⇒ a2 + 3 = 31a/6

Multiplying equation by 6

⇒ 6a2 + 18 = 31a

⇒ 6a2 - 31a + 18 = 0

⇒ 6a2 - 4a - 27a + 18 = 0

⇒ 2a(3a - 2) -9(3a - 2) = 0

⇒ (2a - 9)(3a - 2) = 0

∴ a = 9/2, 2/3

questions.question: The 2 nd and 8 th term of an arithmetic progression are 17 and -1 respectively. What is the 14 th term?
questions.questionHtml: The 2nd and 8th term of an arithmetic progression are 17 and -1 respectively. What is the 14th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of A.P. be a and let the difference be d

⇒ a + d = 17      ----(i)

⇒ a + 7d = -1       ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 6d = -18

⇒ d = -3

Putting the value of d in (i)

⇒ a - 3 = 17

⇒ a = 17 + 3 = 20

So, 14th term = a + 13d = 20 + 13 × (-3) = 20 - 39 = -19

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (2, 3) in the line y = 4?
questions.questionHtml: What is the reflection of the point (2, 3) in the line y = 4?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (2, 3) in the line y = 4

⇒ the equation of line is: y - 4 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x1, y1) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x1)/a = (y - y1)/b = -2(ax1 + by1 + c)/(a2 + b2)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = -4

So, we have

(y - 3)/(1) = -2(3 - 4)/(1) and (x - 2) = 0

⇒ y - 3 = 2 and x = 2

⇒ y = 5 and x = 2

∴ the correct option is 1)

questions.question: Point P (-2, 5) is the midpoint of segment AB. Co-ordinates of A are (-5, y) and B are (x, 3). What is the value of x?
questions.questionHtml: Point P (-2, 5) is the midpoint of segment AB. Co-ordinates of A are (-5, y) and B are (x, 3). What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
We know that the coordinates of mid points of line joining (a1,b1) and (a2,b2) are (a1 + a2)/2 and (b1 + b2)/2

For x coordinate

⇒ -2 = (-5 + x)/2

⇒ -4 = -5 + x

∴ x = 5 - 4 = 1

Multiplying above equation by 3

⇒ 3y = -x + 18

∴ x + 3y = 18

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. BD is its altitude. AD = 4 cm and DC = 12 cm. What is the value of AB (in cm)?
questions.questionHtml: ΔABC is right angled at B. BD is its altitude. AD = 4 cm and DC = 12 cm. What is the value of AB (in cm)?
questions.solution:
Let ∠C be θ

So, In ΔBDC, cotθ = CD/BD

⇒ cotθ = 12/BD      ----(i)

Also, In ΔADB, cot(90° - θ) = AD/BD

⇒ tanθ = 4/BD       ----(ii)

We know that: tanθ = 1/cotθ

⇒ 12/BD = 4/BD

⇒ BD2 = 48

In ΔADB, using Pythagoras theorem

⇒ AD2 + BD2 = AB2

⇒ 42 + 48 = AB2

⇒ AB2 = 64

⇒ AB = 8 cm

∴ the correct option is 4)

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: ΔLMN is right angled at M. If ∠N = 45°. What is the length (in cm) of MN, if NL = 6√2 cm?
questions.questionHtml: ΔLMN is right angled at M. If ∠N = 45°. What is the length (in cm) of MN, if NL = 6√2 cm?
questions.solution:
Given: ∠N = 45°

So, ∠L = 180° - 90° - 45° = 45°

⇒ ΔLMN is an isosceles right angled triangle with LM = MN

Let the two equal sides be a cm

⇒ a2 + a2 = (6√2)2 cm [Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ 2a2 = 2 × 36

⇒ a2 = 36

∴ a = 6 cm

questions.question: If Cos θ = 35/37, then what is the value of Cosec θ?
questions.questionHtml: If Cos θ = 35/37, then what is the value of Cosec θ?
questions.solution:
Given: cosθ = 35/37

We know that: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1

⇒ sin2θ = 1 - cos2θ

⇒ sin2θ = 1 - (35/37)2

⇒ sin2θ = (372 - 352)/372

⇒ sin2θ = 144/372

⇒ sin2θ = (12/37)2

⇒ sinθ = 12/37

So, cosecθ = 1/sinθ = 37/12

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given. Consequent
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.

Consequent
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Ensuing.

Key Points

  • The word "Consequent" means something that follows as a result or effect of a previous action or condition. (परिणामी)
    • Example: The heavy rainfall and consequent flooding caused widespread damage.
  • "Ensuing" refers to something that happens or occurs afterward or as a result. (परिणामी)
    • Example: The argument and the ensuing chaos disrupted the entire meeting.
  • Hence, we can infer that the word similar in meaning to 'Consequent' is 'Ensuing'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Ensuing.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Inception (आरंभ): The beginning of something.
    • Example: The inception of the new project was marked by a grand ceremony.
  • Dawn (भोर): The first light of day; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.
    • Example: The dawn of the digital age has transformed how we communicate.
  • Creation (सृजन): The action or process of bringing something into existence.
    • Example: The creation of the new art piece took several months.

Key Points

    • Example: The contract was in black and white, leaving no room for misunderstandings.
  • "A clear choice that causes no confusion" refers to a decision or statement that is straightforward, leaving no ambiguity. (कोई भ्रम पैदा नहीं करने वाला स्पष्ट विकल्प)
    • Example: The instructions were in black and white, making it a clear choice that caused no confusion.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option(4) i.e. A clear choice that causes no confusion.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Be color blind (रंग अंधा होना): Unable to distinguish certain colors, especially red and green.
    • Example: Being color blind, he finds it hard to differentiate between red and green traffic lights.
  • Not able to appreciate the finer things in life (जीवन की बेहतर चीजों की सराहना नहीं कर पाना): Lacking the ability to enjoy or value higher or more sophisticated aspects of life.
    • Example: He is not able to appreciate the finer things in life, like gourmet food or classical music.
  • Be excessively prejudiced against something or someone (किसी चीज़ या किसी के प्रति अत्यधिक पक्षपाती होना): Displaying unreasonable bias or discrimination.
